description: Resolve a ticker, CIK or company name to the SEC registrant: CIK (plain and 10-digit), official name, tickers, exchanges, SIC code + industry description, entity type, filer category, fiscal year end, state of incorporation, EIN, business address, phone, former names and latest filing, plus up to 9 other name matches. Data: SEC EDGAR public APIs (sec.gov, data.sec.gov), US public domain, no API key. Not-found and upstream errors are not charged. Costs $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

query.description: Ticker (AAPL, BRK.B), CIK (320193 or 0000320193) or company name

name: company_lookup
